fullDescription.text: Kerberoasting attack against Domain Controller DomainController to extract service account credentials.
Vulnerability in the management interface of Firewall leading to critical privilege escalation
Unauthorized privilege escalation on Application Server due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Unauthorized privilege escalation on File Server due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on Application Server leading to system compromise
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on File Server leading to system compromise

Firewall rule misconfiguration allowing unintended traffic to bypass Firewall and reach internal networks
Insecure security configuration or hardening on Application Server leading to information exposure
